Marissa / team — thanks, saw this. Summary of current posture and suggested responses for procurement: 

- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type I in 2025 and are mid-audit for a Type II with an expected reporting date of 2026-09 (Q3 2026). For procurement, we can provide the SOC 2 Type I report today under NDA and share our Type II audit plan and anticipated completion date. Recommended language for questionnaire: "SOC 2 Type I available; Type II expected Q3 2026. Interim evidence available on request (control docs, auditor engagement letter)."

- GDPR: We have a GDPR compliance program in place (DPA template, data processing addendum, data subject request processes, data residency options in EU regions). We can populate the GDPR section with links to the DPA and our data processing workflows.

- HIPAA / BAA: Currently we do not run as a HIPAA-covered service by default. We can enter into a BAA for specific customers but would need to scope the offering (isolate PHI flows, contractually limit processing, enable logging/audit retention). Suggested reply: "HIPAA: can be supported for scoped pilots with a BAA and implementation of specific controls — will require a short enablement project."

- Compliance roadmap: For strategic customers like FinCo, propose we outline an accelerated roadmap: ISO 27001 readiness assessment (Q3 2026), SOC 2 scope expansion (additions based on FinCo's control requirements), and exploratory conversations for FedRAMP advisory if they have federal customers. I've drafted an initial Compliance-Roadmap-Draft.docx and attached it; happy to refine with product/security/legal.

- Risk/Timeline note: If procurement needs an active Type II report to sign production contracts, we should discuss a temporary mitigation (e.g., limited pilot in non-production, strict SLA and monitoring, shorter pilot window) while Type II completes.

I'll start populating the questionnaire (technical/security responses) and tag the items where we need specific legal input (BAA language) or product changes (config for PHI segregation).

Attachment: Compliance-Roadmap-Draft.docx (docx)

—Vivek
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
